summary: Comprehensive Phase 0 technical plan and architectural blueprint for the NLP-Based Customer Complaint Classification project tailored to the Indian consumer grievance domain (Banking & UPI, E-Commerce, Telecom, Utilities, and Consumer Products). Outlines verified dataset schema, text preprocessing, TF-IDF feature pipeline, model benchmark suite (Baseline, Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, Linear SVC), stratified evaluation strategy, Streamlit dashboard and React application showcase, automated tests, and 3-week academic schedule.
